scientific_integrity: The core random spectral law and its atom are proved analytically. The published construction, signed matrix, rank-three input and ordinary entropy bound are explicitly credited. Finite checks are not presented as infinite proofs.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to Oliveira canonical affine Markov interval maps, random fair orientation words, and orientation-weighted symbolic Markov matrices; the orientation-weighted determinant need not be an uncorrected geometric zeta function. Independent priority review and mathematical validation have not been performed.
title: A Gaussian-mixture spectral law with an atom for orientation-weighted interval maps
